in_arabic.name: إقرأ
in_arabic.meaning: اقرأ تعني اقرأ و تعلم و ادرس

in_urdu.name: اقراء
in_urdu.meaning: اقراء مطلب ہے پڑھنا، سیکھنا، اور تعلیم حاصل کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اقراء ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے پڑھنا، سیکھنا، اور تعلیم حاصل کرنا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة اقرأ سے لیا گیا ہے۔ مسلم معاشرے میں یہ نام بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ تعلیم اور علم کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इक़राआ
in_hindi.meaning: इक़राआ का अर्थ है पढ़ना, सीखना और ज्ञान प्राप्त करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इक़राआ एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है पढ़ना, सीखना और ज्ञान प्राप्त करना। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत इकरा से लिया गया है। मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बहुत लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि यह शिक्षा और ज्ञान की महत्ता को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: اقرأ
in_pashto.meaning: اقرأ دى چه مانى يې لوستل، زده کړل او پوهېدل
in_pashto.long_meaning: اقرأ دى يو عربي نوم دى چه مانى يې لوستل، زده کړل او پوهېدل. دا نوم د قرآن کريم د سورت اقرأ نه اخستل شوى دى. په مسلم جامعه كې دا نوم ډير مشهور دى ځكه چې دا د تعليم او پوهې اهميت ښايي

in_english.name: Iqraa
in_english.long_meaning: Iqraa is an Arabic name that means 'read', 'learn', and 'recite'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'Q-R-A' which is also the root of the word 'Quran'. The name Iqraa is significant in Islamic tradition as it is the first word revealed to Prophet Muhammad in the Quran. It symbolizes the importance of reading, learning, and seeking knowledge

data.cultural_impact: The name Iqraa holds immense cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is the opening verse of the Quran, the holy book of Islam. The verse not only signifies the beginning of divine revelation but also serves as a call to knowledge, education, and literacy for all Muslims and humanity as a whole. The name 'Iqraa' is particularly significant in the Islamic educational system, where it is often used as a reminder of the importance of learning and seeking knowledge from the Quran and other sacred texts. It is also a reminder of the role of the Quran in preserving and advancing human knowledge over generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Iqraa also carries profound spiritual significance for Muslims. It is a reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and generosity towards humanity, as He chose to reveal the Quran to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) through the angel Jibreel (AS) to guide and uplift the human race. The command to 'Read' in the name of Allah also symbolizes the importance of reading and reciting the Quran as an essential means of connecting with Allah and seeking His pleasure. It also serves as a reminder of the significance of language in communicating with Allah and understanding His divine will and guidance.
